name: Network Dashboard
description:
Network Dashboard for the Corsair Xeneon Edge.

See connection problems develop over time instead of staring at one ping number. A wide latency ribbon plots HTTPS response timing and leaves visible gaps when a previously verified probe fails.

Three hero metrics show current response latency, jitter across adjacent successful probes, and verified probe loss for the selected window.

Monitor up to five HTTPS hosts. The first host drives the timeline, while the host rail helps separate a broad connection problem from one service having trouble.

Tap the ribbon to cycle 5, 30, and 120 minute windows. Tap the throughput panel to run an on demand Cloudflare download and upload test. Normal probes pause during the throughput test so the test does not create its own fake spike.

The widget measures browser HTTPS response timing, not ICMP ping, and the listing does not claim otherwise.

Last known complete readings stay visible when a fresh request fails, and a host that has never responded successfully is shown as unverified instead of being counted as network loss.

Part of the PackRat 🐀 collection for the Corsair Xeneon Edge.
release_notes: 1.0.1 improves real iCUE behavior and presentation. Host timing now works from the imported file-origin widget without requiring arbitrary probe sites to grant CORS. Custom Header is a true product header with a new 75–180% size control matching Performance Grapher. Header text, monitored-host text size, colors, and background transparency now update live without changing XENEON pages. Transparency affects the outer canvas while metric, latency, monitored-host, and throughput panels stay dark and readable. Adds restrained accent corners and product-line accent wash while preserving HTTPS latency, jitter, probe-loss, host monitoring, time windows, and Cloudflare throughput testing.
